official_title: To suspend the Presidential Proclamation relating to expanding foreign beef imports and establish a Beef Import and Domestic Supply Advisory Board to increase the domestic supply of beef and lower costs for consumers over the long term, and for other purposes.
short_title: Banning External Entry of Foreign Beef Act

titles.title: Banning External Entry of Foreign Beef Act
